description: A coordinated team for evidence-led skill evaluation, Octa-Prompt redesign, and controlled implementation to GitHub.

defaultPrompt: Audit the skill or plugin I provide, redesign it using the eight Octa-Prompt pillars, implement safe in-scope improvements in the specified GitHub repository, verify the changes, and open a pull request.
Run a comprehensive evidence-led evaluation of this skill. Identify root causes, risks, and missing acceptance tests, then provide a prioritized improvement plan.
Review this skill update for regressions, compatibility, security, and GitHub change quality. Verify the exact branch and commit before reporting completion.
interface.longDescription: A three-specialist workflow that audits skills with evidence, redesigns their instructions across all eight Octa-Prompt pillars, then implements safe, traceable improvements in a GitHub working branch and opens a pull request. It distinguishes actual tool execution from procedure-based specialist handoffs and never merges or releases without separate authorization.

name: evaluator-team
